description: Portable ASTRA behavior fixtures. Implementations should agree on observable output, RGBA memory, and error categories; binary identity is not required.

cases.name: scope
cases.source: let x = 1 { let x = 10 print x } print x

cases.name: for continuation
cases.source: for i in 0..4 if (i == 1) continue end print i end

cases.name: stored while condition
cases.source: let flag = 1 while (flag) print flag flag = 0 end

cases.name: recursion
cases.source: fn f(n) if (n <= 1) return 1 end return (n * f((n - 1))) end print f(5)

cases.name: default return
cases.source: fn f() let x = 3 end print f()

cases.name: wrong arity
cases.source: fn f(x) return x end print f()
